messages:
maya (docs): quick heads-up :wave: we need a coordinated deprecation notice + migration guide for the v1 -> v2 API swap on text-generation endpoints. PM wants banner + email next monday. who can own the docs PR?
sam (eng): I can pick up the migration guide draft. need to confirm breaking changes list from SDK team.
lucy (sdk): listed breaking points in the SDK notes: auth header name change, streaming framing change, and model param rename. I can paste snippets.
maya (docs): perfect — include short before/after snippets and a tiny troubleshooting section. keep examples in both curl and TS. also add link to migration checklist.
dmitri (product): critical: model swap will retire v1 'redwood/text-gen-alpha' on 2026-06-01. we need a 30-day advance banner + opt-in grace period. add fallback guidance (how to pin to older model). :warning:
sam (eng): timeline noted. will open PR for docs repo and tag SDK snippets. starting draft now. PR link when created.
lucy (sdk): preliminary TS snippet (v1 -> v2) — please copy into docs code block:
```ts
// v1 (old)
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/text-gen-alpha', prompt: 'hello' });

// v2 (new)
import { Redwood } from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const r = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await r.responses.create({ model: 'redwood/text-gen-v2', input: 'hello' });
```
maya (docs): nice, lucy — I'll shorten that to a 4-line example for the quickstart and keep the full snippet in the migration appendix. also add a note about token accounting differences.
dmitri (product): confirm fallback policy text: "Requests to retired v1 models will 404 after 2026-06-01 unless a dedicated contract exists; use model aliasing to pin a version." ok to add?
sam (eng): OK from infra. also add a troubleshooting note for changed streaming framing: older clients see partial frames, advise upgrading SDK.
lucy (sdk): i'll raise a tiny patch to the JS/TS SDK README with an explicit migration note and link back to the docs PR once it's up.
maya (docs): action items: 1) sam opens docs PR with migration guide + banner copy, 2) lucy adds SDK snippet PR and README note, 3) dmitri confirms exact retirement time for the banner. tagging timeline in the PR.
sam (eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2472 :eyes: will add checklist and link placeholders.
maya (docs): thanks — i'll add email draft to the PR and a short console banner draft under "announcements".
dmitri (product): banner copy draft: "Deprecation: v1 text-gen endpoints retired 2026-06-01. See migration guide." good?
lucy (sdk): LGTM. will coordinate release notes for SDK v2.1 to mention streaming framing fix.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment for text-gen-v2 completed in us-east-1 at 2026-05-01T18:22:00Z.
maya (docs): perfect — i'll merge once sam's checklist is filled and lucy's SDK PR has cross-links. please react with :thumbsup: on the PRs when ready so I can schedule the banner and email.
sam (eng): will do. small ask: can docs include a quick troubleshooting snippet for the 401 -> key header rename? example: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -> -H 'x-rw-api-key: <key>'?
lucy (sdk): yes add that. actual header token change is from Authorization to x-rw-api-key for v2 service. include both examples.
maya (docs): noted. i'll create a short FAQ entry. any objections to the 30-day banner start 2026-05-01?
dmitri (product): 30 days is fine. set automated reminders for the engineering oncall to verify any rollback metrics during the window.
sam (eng): added oncall task to the checklist. merging target: 2026-05-02 so marketing has at least 2 days to review.
maya (docs): perfect — thanks everyone. i'll follow up with PR numbers and the banner/email copy in this thread. :pray:
